title: Dictation
scopeDetail: One download for all your workspaces on this device.
privacy: Speech is processed only on this device.
waitingDetail: Connect to Wi-Fi or Ethernet to download. Mobile data is not used.
preparingDetail: The download is complete. Dictation will be available when preparation finishes.
storageFailed: Not enough space to finish the download.
downloadRecovery: Check your connection, then try again.
storageRecovery: Free up space on this device, then try again.
permissionDetail: Allow microphone access in the system prompt to start recording.
deniedDetail: Allow Situate to use the microphone in your device’s privacy settings, then try dictating again.
noSpeech: No speech was recognized. Try dictating again.
failed: Dictation couldn’t be transcribed. Please dictate again.
interrupted: Dictation was interrupted. The recording was discarded. Please dictate again.
inserted: Text added to your draft. Review it before sending.
busySend: Finish dictation before sending this draft.
offline: Dictation works offline. Sending a message needs an AI connection.
fileBlockedDetail: Review the file that couldn’t be saved before closing. Your chat draft stays available.
agentCloseDetail: Any response still running will stop too. Stopping does not undo changes already made.
leaveRecording: Leaving now discards the recording. Your typed draft stays.
leaveTranscribing: Transcription is still running. Leaving now discards this dictation. Your typed draft stays.
completedDetail: The text is now in your draft. You can stay to review it or continue.
openingA: I’d like to make some time for reading on Thursday.
replyA: What would you like to bring along?
openingB: Let’s choose something for the next reading evening.
replyB: Which book would you like to start with?
draftA: For Thursday: bring something to read.
draftB: Keep a place for the next book.

controls.title: Dictation
controls.note: Synthetic speech and downloads. No microphone, network or AI calls.
